name: know-blueprint
description: v0.2.0 — Turn how you actually work into a structured process model. A guided interview extracts what people forget to write down — triggers, data movement, decision criteria, exceptions, approval authority — then rates every step Automate, Monitor, or Human so you know where automation is safe and where a human must stay in the loop. The ratings are a reviewed draft, not a safety certification, until a stakeholder signs off, which validate is how you run — it walks the ratings one at a time with the person who owns the risk, pressure-tests the exception paths, and records what the pass did not cover, so a partial review never reads as a complete one, and any step that turns on accessibility judgment defaults to Human. Discover sweeps your recurring work into a process inventory when you can't yet name your processes; capture models a process you already run; design models a new one you don't yet, proposing an intended flow grounded in your real constraints and nearest analog, never invented. Five entry points: discover, capture, design, validate, and a guide that routes you. Standalone; runs on its own.
